description.value: Teradata is an enterprise software company that develops and sells database analytics software.
Teradata Corporation is an American enterprise software company that sells database and analytics software, cloud products, and consulting services.
Turns enterprise data into decisions that act, with the Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as its core offering for putting AI to work in business.
Teradata sells an AI and data platform, which it calls the Autonomous Knowledge Platform, aimed at turning enterprise data into automated decisions and actions.
Enterprise data-platform company known for large-scale analytics and data warehousing; sells software, cloud services, support and consulting.

product_description.value: Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform, with components Workspaces, Agents, Agent Execution, Knowledge Context, AI and Foundation; product lines Cloud, Factory, Fabric, AI Studio, Tera and AI Services.

Autonomous Knowledge Platform, including Workspaces, Agents, Agent Execution, Knowledge Context, AI and Foundation; named products Teradata Cloud, Factory (on-premises), Fabric (data access), Tera, AI Studio and AI Services.
Vantage cloud analytics software built on a core relational database with analytics engines; also ClearScape Analytics, IntelliFlex, IntelliCloud and Teradata Everywhere.
Cloud and hardware-based data warehousing, business analytics, and consulting services.
Flagship Vantage platform (VantageCloud), with IntelliSphere, IntelliBase, ClearScape Analytics and QueryGrid.

business_model_description.value: Mixes software licenses, cloud and SaaS offerings, hardware sales, and consulting.

Revenue comes from a mix of software, cloud subscriptions and services; the main shift is converting its on-premises installed base into recurring subscription and cloud relationships through VantageCloud.

customer_description.value: Targets regulated industries: 10 of the top 10 banks, 7 of the top 10 airlines, telecom, logistics and healthcare providers, 3 of the top 5 automotive, 5 of the top 15 life sciences and 4 of the top 10 manufacturers. No individual customers are named.

Emphasizes regulated industries, citing shares of top companies: banks 10 of top 10, airlines, telecom, logistics and healthcare providers 7 of top 10, automotive 3 of top 5, life sciences 5 of top 15, manufacturers 4 of top 10.
Early customers include Citibank (1984 DBC/1012 database machine) and Wal-Mart (first system over 1 terabyte, 1992).
Citibank was an early customer and Wal-Mart the first client for a system over 1 terabyte (1992).
Data-intensive enterprises and government bodies in financial services, communications, government, healthcare, retail, manufacturing and travel/transportation.

revenue.value: $1.836 billion in revenue, net income of $129 million (2020)

founded_year.value: Formed in 1979 in Brentwood, California, from research at Caltech and Citibank's advanced technology group.
Formed in 1979 in Brentwood, California, as a collaboration between researchers at Caltech and Citibank's advanced technology group (one source).

headquarters.value: San Diego, California, with major U.S. locations in Atlanta and San Francisco
